mentions.name: Tarvis
mentions.description: A private managed cloud platform for hosting apps and running agents, positioned as like Coolify but without requiring technical knowledge to host apps. It also supports running AI agents such as Claude and Codex remotely on the VPS, so users don't need to keep their computer or laptop on all the time.
mentions.problem: Hosting apps typically requires technical knowledge, and running agents remotely requires keeping a local computer or laptop on all the time.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A private managed cloud to host apps and run agents.

Give it a try: https://tarvis.io

Its like coolify but cooler since you don't need any technical knowledge to host apps. You can also run claude and codex remotely on the vps without keeping your computer or laptop open all the time.
mentions.author: scottydelta
